title: classification.scan.requested payload (v1)
description: Stage 2 scan request written to the Mongo outbox when Stage 1 says a scan is required. Pointer to the archived event only. Producer: events. Exchange: aegispulse.enrichment. FRs: FR-CLS-03, FR-CLS-06. Describes only the envelope `payload` (PROJECT.md §6.4, §6.7); consumers ignore unknown fields (NFR-13).
